question: Following the 2026 reshuffle, which individual has been moved from the governorship of Telangana to become the Governor of Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jishnu Dev Varma.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu sanctioned the transfer and appointment of several Governors on March 6, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jishnu Dev Varma, who was serving as the Governor of Telangana, has been appointed as the Governor of Maharashtra.**
 
• **Shiv Pratap Shukla, the former Governor of Himachal Pradesh, has been moved to Telangana to fill the vacancy.**
 
• **The reshuffle reflects the periodic realignment of state constitutional heads by the Central Government.**
 
• **As per the Constitution, the Governor acts as the nominal head of the state executive.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Shiv Pratap Shukla__

 __
 
• Appointed as the new Governor of Telangana.
 
 
 
• Nand Kishore Yadav__
 __
 
• Former Bihar Speaker; Appointed as Governor of Nagaland.
 
 
 
• Syed Ata Hasnain__
 __
 
• Retired Lieutenant General; Appointed as the new Governor of Bihar.
 
 
 
• Appointment Tenure__
 
 
• A Governor holds office during the pleasure of the President, usually for a term of five years.
